Tantivy 0.25 embedded search-kernel comparator with a persistent stdin/stdout process.
Consumes the same normalized JSONL/plain-text corpus and assigns zero-based u32 ordinals in input order.
Uses SimpleTokenizer over an ASCII-lowercased copy of the text, preserving non-ASCII case to match Antfly's declared simple analyzer.
Indexes corpus_ordinal as a native u64 fast field; result mapping never loads stored source bodies.
Supports only strict V1 TERM/UNION/INTERSECTION/PHRASE queries and fails closed with UNSUPPORTED.
Tantivy 0.25 exposes fixed BM25 k1=1.2 and b=0.75, so the adapter rejects other values instead of claiming score equivalence.
Single mode explicitly merges all searchable segments; production mode retains the commit-per-5000-doc ingestion state.
